name: 10% AHA Body Scrub (200g)
subtitle: De-tans, Reduces Strawberry Skin, Exfoliates
usageInstructions: Take a handful of body scrub and apply it on a wet body. Gently scrub the body in circular motions. Focus on the neck, elbows, knees, underarms & feet. Rinse with warm water and pat dry. Follow up with body wash.
description: Our 10% AHA Body Scrub combines the power of chemical and physical exfoliation to target stubborn skin concerns. ➡️ Reduce Strawberry Skin : Dual exfoliation effectively reduces the appearance of "strawberry skin".🍓 ➡️ Remove Body Tan : Lactic acid exfoliates the dead skin cells, which helps in tan removal ☀️ ➡️ Combat Ingrown Hair : Our scrub helps prevent ingrown hairs by removing dead skin cells and unclogging hair follicles. ➡️ Lactic acid and Oat extract soothe and protect the skin, reducing inflammation and the likelihood of ingrown hairs. 🚫 ➡️ Experience Smooth & Soft Skin : Infused with soothing aloe vera, this scrub also replenishes essential moisture, leaving your skin feeling soft, supple, and revitalized.💧
usage: Step 1 : Take a handful of scrub on your palms. Step 2 : Apply on damp skin & massage in gentle, circular motions. Step 3 : Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm/cold water. Use 1-2 times a week for 3 months for best results!

list.title: Important Information
list.content:
Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

list.title: Can I use 10% AHA Body Scrub every day?
list.content: No, we recommend using this body scrub for all skin types once-twice a week

list.title: Is cleanser good for all skin types?
list.content: Yes - this body scrub can be used by all skin types.

list.title: How much time will it take to see results?
list.content: We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months

list.title: Do I need to use this before or after soap?
list.content: It is recommended to clean before exfoliating, hence best results are seen when scrub is used after using soap or body wash.

list.title: How does this help with de-tanning?
list.content: Our 10% AHA Body Scrub effectively helps remove tan by combining the power of physical and chemical exfoliation. The natural silica beads gently scrub away dead skin cells, while lactic acid dissolves the top layer of tanned skin, revealing a brighter, more even complexion.

list.title: Are there any side-effects?
list.content: No, there are no side-effects of this product.  But a patch test is recommended prior to use.

list.title: How does it remove strawberry skin?
list.content: Our 10% AHA Body Scrub effectively targets strawberry skin by combining physical and chemical exfoliation. The natural silica beads unclog pores and remove dead skin cells, while lactic acid gently dissolves impurities. Oat extract, known for its skin barrier-protecting properties, soothes and hydrates the skin, reducing redness and irritation often associated with strawberry skin. Regular use helps refine skin texture and improve overall skin clarity.

list.title: Will it make my skin dry?
list.content: Our scrub exfoliates gently and lactic acid present attracts and retains moisturise,  which leaves your skin feeling soft and moisturised.

list.title: What do I need to do before and after scrubbing?
list.content: Before using scrub, gently cleanse your body to remove dirt, excess oil, using a body wash or soap. After exfoliating, it is recommended to use a body lotion or moisturizer.

list.title: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
list.content: Our scrub is gentle on skin, so it will not cause any harm to sensitive skin.  But it is recommended to do a patch test, especially for sensitive skin to test it out prior usage.

list.title: Can someone below 18 use it?
list.content: We recommend only women above 18 years of age to use it.

list.title: Can men use it?
list.content: All our products are designed keeping women’s needs in mind and are recommended for women above the age of 18. While men can definitely use it, we cannot guarantee the efficacy for men. Also we have a separate website for men’s care products. To visit it please click here https://manmatters.com/ .
